summary: Ticker-relationship mapping for one Technology candidate chunk, focused on underfollowed AI infrastructure second-order beneficiaries across data-center cooling, electrical distribution, site infrastructure, power components, cybersecurity/data governance, and industrial IoT. Powell Industries has the strongest primary-source support in this chunk due to disclosed fiscal Q2 2026 orders, backlog, and a post-quarter data-center order exceeding $400 million. Modine, nVent, Sterling, Bel Fuse, Vicor, Varonis, Tenable, SentinelOne, and Samsara remain mostly hypothesis-level mappings pending company-level evidence on AI/data-center revenue mix, backlog, customer wins, ARR quality, and product-level exposure. No buy/sell recommendation, target price, or return forecast is provided.
